notes:
Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/74). Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json collector_number 74): "Enchant creature\nWhen this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.\nEnchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.\nWhen enchanted creature is dealt damage, sacrifice this Aura." 1 old-shape source pair (bare zone:'Graveyard' + event:'dies', no annotations) -> 6 source facts + 1 sink, all annotated: baseline self-cast/self-enters (typeLine-anchored 'Enchantment'), a real event:'tap' fact (target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true — 'tap enchanted creature'), a NEW event:'grantKeyword' fact (keyword:'CantUntap', target:{equippedBySelf:true} — 'doesn't untap...'), and the sacrifice ACT + merged dies CONSEQUENCE pair (both anchored to 'sacrifice this Aura', same ACT-vs-CONSEQUENCE split summon-bahamut's own migration established). Sink (wants a creature on the battlefield) unchanged in substance, just re-shaped to `to`/annotations.

Two real engine additions this pass, both narrow, both matching an already-established precedent shape (checked ENGINE_GAPS.md's current list first, per this task's own instruction, before assuming either was unsupported):
1. Real targeted Aura-attach: definition.ts's onEnter trigger is now a `custom` effect that resolves the real cast-time declared target (`ctx.declaredTargets`, ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #4 — survives untouched into this ETB trigger's own `ctx` since an Aura has no `effects` of its own to drain it first) or falls back to `chooseTarget`, then calls REAL `actions.equip(ctx.self, target)` (the same primitive every migrated Equipment card already uses) before tapping it — genuine attach, not a bare `tapTarget` stand-in that skips the attach step.
2. New `'CantUntap'` Keyword (card.ts) + a real check in `state.untap()` (checked FIRST, before the pre-existing STUN counter check) implementing CR 614.2's 'doesn't untap during untap step' as an unconditional, non-consuming continuous lockdown — genuinely different in kind from a stun counter (one-shot consumption vs. always-on for as long as attached). Broadcast via the pre-existing `continuousKeywordGrants`/`equippedBySelf` machinery (the SAME Equipment-broadcast mechanism Dragoon's Lance's own 'equipped creature has flying' already uses) — no new grant-targeting mechanism invented, just a new keyword value consulted at the untap chokepoint. Real Forge citation: `res/cardsfolder/s/sleep_magic.txt`'s `R:Event$ Untap | ValidCard$ Creature.EnchantedBy | ... | Layer$ CantHappen`. New tests: state.test.ts's two new `CantUntap` cases in the `GameState.tap / untap` describe block (non-consuming lockdown vs. a stun counter; genuinely follows a live re-equip and turns off once detached). This mechanism is NOT separately demonstrated live in this card's own flat harness.ts scenario — `harness.ts`'s scenario runner never copies `continuousKeywordGrants` onto the `RealCard`s it builds (only engine.ts's real castSpell/resolveTop pilot path does), same limitation Dragoon's Lance's own equipped-creature grants already have; real coverage lives in state.test.ts instead, same documented tradeoff that card's own scenarios.ts already states.

Genuinely checked and confirmed UNSUPPORTED, not fabricated: the trigger CONDITION 'when enchanted creature is dealt damage' has no auto-fire hook anywhere in this engine — `Trigger.on` only recognizes 'enter'/'upkeep'/'endStep' (card.ts), and `state.dealDamage` (the one real chokepoint gap #8's damage-prevention shields hook into) fires no trigger of any kind. Kept as a manually-named trigger (`onEnchantedDealtDamage`), exercised directly by this card's own second scenario — same convention every other not-yet-auto-fired trigger in the pool already uses; not a new limitation, just newly documented against the current (2026-09-12) gap list. A general damage-triggered auto-fire dispatcher was deliberately NOT built this pass — no other real FIN card in this pool needs one yet (checked), so it would be speculative machinery for a one-card need; flagged in ENGINE_GAPS.md instead of built.

Scenarios: kept the pre-existing 2 (one per real trigger). First scenario changed from a bare `trigger:'onEnter'` (the same 'mythical enter' shortcut ice-flan's/dragoon-s-lance's own scenarios.ts already document and fixed) to `sequence:['onEnter']`, so the baseline self-cast/self-enters facts get real `fn:'cast'`/`fn:'enters'` trace evidence instead of none. Regenerated trace.json via `run-scenarios.mjs` (scoped to this card only — an earlier, unscoped full-pool run accidentally regenerated ~300 other cards' trace.json files reflecting an unrelated wording change and a concurrent session's own uncommitted work; reverted every one of those via `git checkout` before finishing, confirmed only sleep-magic's own trace.json stayed changed).

Verification: `verify-synergy.mjs sleep-magic` — 0 hard failures (1 soft note: 'trace has equip ... with no matching declared produce', same expected, pre-existing 'equip' PARKED_ACTION_FNS treatment every other Equipment/Aura card in the pool already gets — no dedicated 'attach' event vocabulary exists since no sink in the pool wants one). Full-pool `verify-synergy.mjs`: 320 checked, 7 pre-existing hard failures, all on cards currently mid-migration by concurrent sessions per `git status` (al-bhed-salvagers, sahagin, stuck-in-summoner-s-sanctum, summon-leviathan, thief-s-knife, ultros-obnoxious-octopus, valkyrie-aerial-unit) — none touched or caused by this pass. `vitest run functional-model`: 351/351 (349 pre-existing + 2 new CantUntap tests). `find-synergies.mjs` before/after diff (isolated via a temporary HEAD-content swap of just this card's synergy.json, not a stale git-HEAD pool diff): +38/-22 interaction lines — 19 are a pure LABEL rename ('graveyard presence' -> 'dies', same 19 real cards, net zero, expected once `to`/`from` let `zoneMovementName` name the pair), 19 are genuinely NEW ('enters the battlefield' matches — the self-enters fact didn't exist in the old 2-fact version at all), 3 are a real, ACCEPTED, already-documented shape-family regression (Judge Magister Gabranth, Sephiroth Fabled SOLDIER, Zodiark Umbral God — real event-only `event:'dies'` sinks that used to match the old bare EventFact half and no longer do once merged with real zone data, the identical tradeoff SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's own summon-bahamut 'Fact unification' section already documents and accepts). The sink side (X --> Sleep Magic, 'wants a creature on the battlefield') is byte-identical before/after (79/79 lines) — unaffected, as expected.
knownGaps: 'Enchant creature' has no real 'legal enchant target' restriction enforcement anywhere in this model — an Aura's own cast has no gate distinct from a bare chooseTarget pool pick; kept as free text (staticAbilities), same acknowledged limitation stuck-in-summoner-s-sanctum's own definition.ts already documents for fin's other real Aura.

The trigger condition 'when enchanted creature is dealt damage' has no real auto-fire hook — Trigger.on only recognizes 'enter'/'upkeep'/'endStep', and state.dealDamage fires no trigger of any kind. onEnchantedDealtDamage stays a manually-named trigger, exercised directly by this card's own scenario rather than engine-detected. Real Forge citation for the missing condition: res/cardsfolder/s/sleep_magic.txt's `T:Mode$ DamageDoneOnce | ValidTarget$ Card.AttachedBy | ...`.

'Sacrifice THIS Aura' (as opposed to 'an enchantment you control') has no dedicated self-only sacrifice target in this model's `sacrifice` Effect shape (only `notSelf`, which EXCLUDES self) — approximated as 'sacrifice an enchantment you control,' correct only when this Aura is the sole enchantment on the battlefield (true in this card's own scenario). Pre-existing limitation, unchanged by this pass.

The real Aura-attach action (`actions.equip`) has no dedicated Fact/event vocabulary of its own — stays on verify-synergy.mjs's PARKED_ACTION_FNS list pool-wide (no card in the corpus wants an 'equip'/'attach' event today), same treatment every other migrated Equipment/Aura card already gets.
